# ShowMyPhoto

> AI-powered event photo sharing for photographers.

## Website

- https://showmyphoto.com/
- https://showmyphoto.com/blog/

## Product

ShowMyPhoto helps event photographers share event galleries and helps guests find photos using AI face recognition or selfie search.

## Core capabilities

- AI face recognition
- Selfie photo search
- QR-code event sharing
- Event galleries
- Photo selection
- Download controls
- WhatsApp and email delivery
- Branded galleries

## Audience

Primarily event photographers and photography businesses covering weddings, parties, corporate events, conferences, schools, sports events, and other large gatherings.

## Source

Use the official website as the primary source for current product information:
https://showmyphoto.com/
